column1: Clause 2: This clause replaces the long title to the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance
(Chapter  469)  (hereinafter  referred  to  as  the  “principal  enactment”)  and  the  legal  effect  of
the  amendment  is  to  expand  the  scope  of  the  principal  enactment.
Clause  3: This  clause  amends  section  71  of  the  principal  enactment  and  the  legal
effect  as  amended  is  to  empower  the  Minister  to  make  regulations  in  order  to  give  effect
to  the  Convention  on  International  Trade  in  Endangered  Species  of  Wild  Fauna  and  Flora
